description.zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
- global：项目下全局资源
- custom：指定项目范围下的资源
description.en:
The scope of authorized resources. Valid values:
- global: all resources under the project.
- custom: specified resources under the project.

description.zh: 授权规则名称，长度限制最大64个字符。
description.en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a parameter value, but make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

description.zh: 授权规则描述，长度限制最大128个字符。
description.en: The description of the authorization rule. The description can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 授权规则关联的项目ID，当不确定关联项目时，可关联默认项目，默认项目为iprj_system_default。
description.en: The ID of the project associated with the authorization rule. If you are unsure which project to associate, you can associate the default project. The default project ID is iprj_system_default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-authorization-rule --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --authorization-rule-name test_rule --project-id iprj_system_default --authorization-resource-scope global --description this_is_a_test_rule --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateAuthorizationRule --region cn-hangzhou --AuthorizationResourceScope global --Description this_is_a_test_rule --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ProjectId iprj_system_default --AuthorizationRuleName test_rule --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
